evidence_kind: Matching PE/PDB static instruction facts; original movie pixels are independently decoded locally, not committed.

native_frame_window.fields: AnimationData full offsets: NumFrames+0x310, StartFrame+0x330, EndFrame+0x334.
native_frame_window.post_read: AnimationData.PostRead RVA0x97550: default frame-count substitution at RVA0x977ae..0x977e1 only enters when current NumFrames==0, StartFrame==1 and EndFrame==0. Explicit positive NumFrames bypasses that substitution. Book type0 at RVA0x977ee..0x977f0 enters the Book frame-range branch.
native_frame_window.book_end: RVA0x9787c..0x978b1: when EndFrame==0, derive EndFrame=StartFrame+NumFrames-1; an explicitly positive NumFrames is not replaced by carrier frame count.
native_frame_window.init: Book.Init RVA0x2af3cf reads source StartFrame (or EndFrame for backwards) and initializes current frame.
native_frame_window.update: Book.UpdateInternal RVA0x2af5a5/0x2af65a/0x2af6cc/0x2af70a reads source StartFrame/EndFrame for displayed clamp and finite completion; it does not extend the authored window merely because the decoded Bink carrier has more frames.
native_frame_window.bounded_prefix_policy: A complete positive single-angle Book window StartFrame1..NumFrames can retain the first authored frames of a longer original carrier. Require actual carrier count>=NumFrames and record the exact unused tail count. This is a source-defined window, not a synthetic shorter animation. FrameDataFile, other windows, unsupported origin and unreviewed timing consumers reject.

portable_resource_binding.schema: Optional EmbeddedMovieDefinitions and EmbeddedMovieBankSha256 in the action catalog; embedded_movie_bank and embedded_movie_source_manifest identities in its resource manifest. Existing atlas Definitions and actor-bank MovieDefinitions stay separate and retain prior identities.
portable_resource_binding.runtime: All three image banks use native Book/Constant/action lifecycle consumers. A centralized immutable name-to-bank lookup selects actual pixels; embedded Books keep movie geometry normalization and native source timing.
portable_resource_binding.pack_policy: Small dedicated HAA1 companion avoids rewriting large original atlas/actor banks and avoids their aggregate decoded-frame budgets. Pack roles and HAA layout are portable delivery policy, not recovered proprietary engine file layout.
portable_resource_binding.verification: Stage validates original source definition/inheritance, movie/atlas identity, complete frame window, unused tail, pinned alpha-capable decoder, HAA geometry/order/timing, and every compressed frame extent/CRC/source crop hash. Source inputs and prior banks remain immutable.

limitations: Static source-window facts do not establish physical-device rendering or native material/lighting parity.
New binding admits only complete authored single-angle Book windows without FrameDataFile; existing legacy movie bindings retain their established limits.
